system.description: A richly dressed and adorned aristocrat brimming with hubris.
system.notes:
Normal | Social

A richly dressed and adorned aristocrat brimming with hubris. Motives & Tactics: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

Difficulty: 14 | Thresholds: 6/10 | HP: 3 | Stress: 5

ATK: -3 | Weapon: Melee | 1d6+1 physical

Experience: Aristocrat +3

Features

My Land, My Rules - Passive: All social actions made against the Noble on their land have Disadvantage.

Guards, Seize Them! - Action: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4 Guards, who appear at Far range.

Exile - Action: Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Noble exiles the target and their allies, giving them Disadvantage in social situations within their domain.

Execute Them! - Action: Spend a Fear per PC to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A successful Charm roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.
